Biggest Single Number

https://leetcode.com/problems/biggest-single-number/description/

Solved on 2026-08-29

A single number is a number that appeared only once in the MyNumbers table.

Find the largest single number. If there is no single number, report null.

## Solution

```{sql}
-- Write your PostgreSQL query statement below
SELECT MAX(num) AS num
FROM (
    SELECT
        num
    FROM
        MyNumbers
    GROUP BY
        num
        HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
)
```

## Explanation

The inner query returns a list of number that appear only once in the table (pretty simple to see that HAVING clause asscomplishes this). The SELECT MAX(num) then returns the biggest number from this list or a null value if there are no single numbers, as required by the problem statement.
